admin-collect-token-metrics.name: Collect Token Metrics
admin-collect-token-metrics.description: Incrementally scan OpenClaw session transcripts and write immutable hourly token-usage buckets.

admin-refresh-sessions.name: Session Refresh
admin-refresh-sessions.description: Reset idle top-level gateway sessions whose last turn carried a large context (sessions.list/reset through the gateway, usage from the agent DB); busy or recently active sessions are never touched. Ships as a dry run; the enabling delta adds --live.

admin-refresh-token-rates.name: Refresh Token Rates
admin-refresh-token-rates.description: Seed the token rate card if missing, then refresh per-model $/MTok rates from the OpenRouter model API (no LLM). Fails if the rate card is missing or invalid, or any provider model can't be resolved.

admin-sweep-orphaned-tmp.name: Sweep Orphaned Tmp Files
admin-sweep-orphaned-tmp.description: Remove orphaned .tmp files left by crashed atomic write operations in workspace directories.

admin-check-qdrant-health.name: Qdrant Health Check
admin-check-qdrant-health.description: Monitor Qdrant liveness (/healthz), collection status and optimizer health. Attempt a non-interactive service restart when Qdrant is down, a collection is red or the optimizer is stuck; exit non-zero (restart requires operator) when the restart is denied or fails.

admin-review-skill-proposals.name: Review Skill Proposals
admin-review-skill-proposals.description: Daily review of pending Skill Workshop proposals against the skill inventory: a worker classifies each and flags risks; the script writes the report, posts a numbered summary and watches the skills catalog budget. Applies nothing. Ships as a dry run; the enabling delta adds --live.
